description: Send the configured incentive to a BYOP participant. Check the participant and reward amount (byop_config.incentive_amount from get_study). For API keys requiring approval, the first call previews the reward. Show it to the human, then submit the returned chat_approval_nonce with human_confirmed=true only after explicit approval. Keys configured without approval can send directly when requested. For other connections, confirm the recipient and amount with the human. Reuse idempotency_key on uncertain retries.

chat_approval_nonce.description: One-time approval nonce from the reward preview.

human_confirmed.description: Set only after the human approves this participant and reward amount.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

participant_id.description: UUID of the BYOP participant, as returned by list_participants.

name: send_participant_reward
title: Send Participant Reward
